info.title: macrodeck-plugin
info.description: macrodeck-plugin: the Macro Deck plugin developer CLI. Validate a manifest, inspect or pack a .macroDeckPlugin artifact, run a plugin against a stub or real host, and run the conformance suite against it - all as a dotnet tool.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: macrodeck-plugin: build, validate, inspect, pack, run, test, sign and verify Macro Deck plugins without a running host.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: How much a command narrates while it works. [default: Normal]

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable ANSI color in text output. [default: False]

commands.name: new
commands.description: Scaffold a new Macro Deck plugin project.

options.name: --name
options.description: The plugin's human-readable display name.

options.name: --id
options.description: The plugin's reverse-domain id, e.g. 'com.example.my-plugin'.

options.name: --publisher
options.description: The publisher's display name.

options.name: --description
options.description: A short description of the plugin.

options.name: --repository
options.description: The source repository URL.

options.name: --homepage
options.description: The project homepage URL.

options.name: --license
options.description: An SPDX license identifier. Defaults to MIT.

options.name: --project-name
options.description: The C# project name. Derived from --name when omitted.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory to scaffold the project into. Defaults to './<project name>'.

options.name: --platform
options.description: A target runtime identifier. Repeat for each platform.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Never prompt; accept every value the wizard would have offered as a default. [default: False]

options.name: --non-interactive
options.description: Never prompt; fail if a required value was not supplied, rather than defaulting it. [default: False]

options.name: --template-version
options.description: Install this exact plugin project template version instead of the latest prerelease.

options.name: --skip-template-install
options.description: Never probe or install the plugin project template; it must already be installed. [default: False]

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Skip the automatic NuGet restore 'dotnet new' would otherwise run. [default: False]

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build every runtime identifier the manifest declares and package the result.

options.name: --source
options.description: The plugin project directory to build. [default: .]

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Path to manifest.json. Defaults to <source>/manifest.json.

options.name: --build-config
options.description: Path to macrodeck-build.json. Defaults to the file beside the manifest.

options.name: --rid
options.description: Build only this runtime identifier, which the manifest must declare. Defaults to building every declared runtime identifier.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory to write the artifact to. The name comes from the plugin id and version. [default: .]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing artifact. [default: False]

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate a plugin manifest, version directory, or artifact.

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Path to a manifest.json file.

options.name: --artifact
options.description: Path to a .macroDeckPlugin artifact.

options.name: --directory
options.description: A version directory containing manifest.json.

options.name: --output
options.description: How to render the result. [default: Text]

options.name: --level
options.description: How strictly to validate: development, package or publication. Defaults from the selector (development for --manifest/--directory, package for --artifact).

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Report what installing an artifact or version directory would find.

options.name: --artifact
options.description: Path to a .macroDeckPlugin artifact.

options.name: --directory
options.description: A version directory containing manifest.json.

options.name: --show-digest
options.description: Also print the manifest's signable digest, base64-encoded - the exact bytes a signature is computed over. [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: How to render the result. [default: Text]

commands.name: pack
commands.description: Build a .macroDeckPlugin artifact from a source tree.

options.name: --source
options.description: The payload directory to pack. [default: .]

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Path to manifest.json. Defaults to <source>/manifest.json.

options.name: --output
options.description: Where to write the artifact. Defaults to <id>-<version>.macroDeckPlugin.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing output file. [default: False]

options.name: --show-digest
options.description: Also print the packed manifest's signable digest, base64-encoded - the exact bytes a signature is computed over. [default: False]

commands.name: run
commands.description: Launch a plugin against a stub or real host, streaming its output.

options.name: --project
options.description: A plugin's .csproj, or its directory.

options.name: --executable
options.description: An already-built executable or framework-dependent .dll.

options.name: --artifact
options.description: A packed .macroDeckPlugin artifact.

options.name: --host-url
options.description: A real host's URL. Defaults to the running desktop host, discovered through its loopback port file.

options.name: --stub-host
options.description: Run against a disposable in-process stub host instead of a real one. [default: False]

options.name: --mode
options.description: managed or self-registering. Defaults to self-registering. [default: SelfRegistering]

options.name: --enrollment-token
options.description: Self-registering only. Required against a real host unless --pairing is left enabled (the default); defaults to a placeholder against --stub-host.

options.name: --pairing
options.description: Self-registering only. Whether the plugin may fall back to interactive pairing when no --enrollment-token is given. Defaults to true. [default: True]

options.name: --plugin-id
options.description: Managed only. Defaults to the id declared by the manifest.json next to the launch target; a generated development id when no manifest is found.

options.name: --secret
options.description: Managed only. Defaults to a generated secret against --stub-host.

options.name: --state-directory
options.description: Self-registering only. Where the persisted credential is stored. Defaults to a temporary directory.

options.name: --data-directory
options.description: Managed only. Defaults to a temporary directory.

options.name: --instance-id
options.description: Both modes. Defaults to a fresh id.

options.name: --launch-id
options.description: Managed only, diagnostic. Defaults to a fresh id.

options.name: --listen-url
options.description: Where the plugin listens. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:0 (an OS-chosen loopback port).

commands.name: test
commands.description: Run the plugin conformance suite against a project, executable or artifact.

options.name: --project
options.description: A plugin's .csproj, or its directory.

options.name: --executable
options.description: An already-built executable or framework-dependent .dll.

options.name: --artifact
options.description: A packed .macroDeckPlugin artifact.

options.name: --category
options.description: Restrict to one category (repeatable). See --list-checks for the vocabulary. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --check
options.description: Restrict to one check id (repeatable). [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --required-only
options.description: Run only Required checks. [default: False]

options.name: --report
options.description: text, json or markdown. Defaults to text. [default: Text]

options.name: --output
options.description: Where to write the report. Defaults to stdout.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Per-check timeout, in seconds.

options.name: --list-checks
options.description: List every check id, category and requirement level, and exit. [default: False]

commands.name: keygen
commands.description: Generate a creator Ed25519 key pair for 'sign'.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory to write the key pair into. [default: .]

options.name: --key-name
options.description: Base file name for the key pair. [default: macrodeck-creator]

commands.name: sign
commands.description: Sign a plugin, icon pack, profile, folder or widget package.

options.name: --output
options.description: Where to write the signed artifact.

options.name: --certificate
options.description: Path to the signing certificate (certificate.json).

options.name: --certificate-signature
options.description: Path to the root's signature over the certificate (certificate.sig).

options.name: --private-key
options.description: Path to the base64-encoded private key.

options.name: --root-public
options.description: Verify the certificate against this root public key instead of the pinned Macro Deck root. Not for production use.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify a signed plugin, icon pack, profile, folder or widget package.

options.name: --root-public
options.description: Verify the certificate against this root public key instead of the pinned Macro Deck root. Not for production use.

options.name: --output
options.description: How to render the result. [default: Text]
